issue: Singleton Dispose is non-reentrant: after the 2nd connect/disconnect cycle in one process, `_disposed` is already true so Dispose early-returns and the named semaphore is never released, permanently blocking other VPNRouter instances (Windows Service) from acquiring the TUN lock until the desktop app exits
fix: Reset `_instance = null` inside Dispose (or make Dispose re-armable by clearing `_disposed` and re-creating the semaphore in TryAcquire when `_semaphore == null && _disposed`), so each SingBoxManager lifecycle gets a functional lock instance.
